summary: Top Wealth Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing that non-executive director and board chairman Kim Kwan Kings Wong resigned effective September 18, 2026, citing health issues and no disagreement with the company. The same date, all issued shares of controlling shareholder Winwin Development Group Limited were transferred to Wong's son, Jiaxi Huang, who also joined Winwin's board. Winwin's holding is unchanged at 7,845,248 Class A shares (13.2%) and 3,166,667 Class B shares, about 86.2% of voting power. CEO Yuen Cheong Carp Lee continues running operations. Watch governance continuity and any shift in control intent.
